# @aponiajs/terminus

> Nest-compatible Terminus health checks and indicators for AponiaJS (`TerminusModule`, `HealthCheckService`, `@HealthCheck()`, HTTP, memory, and disk indicators).

## Key exports

- `TerminusModule.forRoot(options)` / `TerminusModule.forRootAsync(options)`
- `HealthCheckService`
- `@HealthCheck()`
- `HealthIndicatorService` / `HealthIndicator`
- `HttpHealthIndicator` / `MemoryHealthIndicator` / `DiskHealthIndicator`

- [Package README](./README.md)
